name: Musical Terms
description: Musical terms word search puzzles collect theory and rehearsal vocabulary — tempo, dynamics, cadence, chord, clef, harmony and fermata — for adults who read music or simply like precise English. Free online; easy through hard plus large print. No artist names, no label brands and no film-score franchises: only the shared language of lessons and choirs. Parent theme: Music, with siblings Instruments, Jazz and Classical. No timer and no account. Prefer bigger letters? Use large print. First time on Words at Rest? Read how to play, then pick a grid that matches how awake your eyes feel.
